description: This file defines the NodePermissions class in Drupal, responsible for generating dynamic permissions related to node types, including create, edit, delete, view revisions, revert revisions, and delete revisions permissions for different node types.

classes.name: NodePermissions
classes.description: Provides dynamic permissions for nodes of different types within Drupal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the entity type manager, with deprecation warning if not provided.

methods.name: nodeTypePermissions
methods.description: Returns an array of permissions related to node types.

methods.name: buildPermissions
methods.description: Builds a list of permissions for a specific node type, including create, edit, delete, and revision permissions.
